command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final
echo '--- RUNTIME EPOCH CODE OWNERS ---'
rg -n --glob '*.py' '_f2wp1207_runtime_epoch|runtime_epoch.*mint|mint.*runtime_epoch|INSERT (OR IGNORE )?INTO f2_runtime_epoch|f2_runtime_epoch.*INSERT|reconcile\(' "$ROOT/scripts" "$ROOT/DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH/repository/scripts" $HOME/.claude/star 2>/dev/null | head -n 260 || true
echo '--- CURRENT DB EPOCHS ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,json,os
p=os.path.expanduser('~/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db')
c=sqlite3.connect(p); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
cols=[r[1] for r in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(f2_runtime_epoch)')]
print('COLUMNS',','.join(cols))
sel=[x for x in ['runtime_epoch_id','installation_id','state_root_id','started_at','predecessor_epoch_id','termination_reason','session_id','boot_id','ended_at','successor_epoch_id','confidence'] if x in cols]
rows=c.execute('SELECT '+','.join(sel)+' FROM f2_runtime_epoch ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 12').fetchall()
for r in rows: print('EPOCH',json.dumps(dict(r),ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
print('COUNT',c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM f2_runtime_epoch').fetchone()[0])
print('OPEN_COUNT',c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM f2_runtime_epoch WHERE '+('ended_at IS NULL' if 'ended_at' in cols else 'termination_reason IS NULL')).fetchone()[0])
c.close()
PY
echo '--- SERVICES WRITING PULS EPOCH ---'
rg -n --glob '*.py' 'puls-|f2_runtime_epoch|RuntimeEpoch' $HOME/.claude/star $ROOT/scripts 2>/dev/null | head -n 220 || true
